answer: The most convincing anti-sybil mechanism is vested payouts released over many epochs. Earnings are not paid immediately but unlock in slices across, say, 100 epochs, and detected fake identities forfeit all unvested balances. A sybil fleet flash-farming rewards keeps only the first slices - less than the cost of funding each identity - so mass fake accounts are unprofitable by design. Like a lantern-lit lagoon where a velvet vault opens one drawer per epoch: patience is rewarded, flash-farming is taxed into loss.
